subject: general
question: The Finance Commission is a constitutionally mandated body, set up under Article _______ of the Constitution of India.
solution:
The correct answer is** '__280__'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Finance Commission** of India is a constitutionally mandated body established by the Indian President under the** Article 280** of the Constitution of India in **1951**.
 
• The commission was established to outline the** financial ties **between the **state and the centre**.
 
• The terms, eligibility, and **powers **of the Finance Commission are outlined in the Finance Commission Act of 1951, along with the requirements for qualification, appointment, and disqualification.
 
• As per the Constitution, the **Finance Commission** is appointed every **five years** and consists of **five members**, a chairman and four other members.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** taxes on professions**, trades, callings, and employment are described in** Article** **276** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Grants in lieu of** export duty on jute** and jute products are covered in **Article 273** of the Indian Constitution, which also states that the **Consolidated Fund of India** shall be charged with such sums as may be prescribed each year as grants in aid of the revenues of the States of Assam, Bihar, Orissa, and West Bengal, in lieu of assignment of any share of the net proceeds of export duty on jute and jute products to those States.
 
• The exemption from state** taxes of water or electricity** in certain circumstances is covered by the** Article 288** of the Constitution of India.
